marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind north 20 knots except light in Prince Albert Sound. Wind
diminishing to northeast 15 near noon. Wind northeast 15 tonight and
Thursday. Scattered flurries changing to snow this evening.
Visibility as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near minus 5. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre except less than 1 in Prince Albert Sound
today.<br/>
